checks.h1: Machinery, plant and safety equipment

images.alt: An alluvial gold wash plant combines washing, screening and gravity separation to process gold-bearing gravel.
A hydraulic excavator uses its boom and bucket to dig material and load haul trucks.
A wheel loader scoops loose material from stockpiles and loads it into trucks or feed hoppers.
A dump truck carries ore, waste rock and construction material in a tipping body.
A bulldozer pushes and spreads material with its front blade during site preparation and road work.
A motor grader shapes road surfaces and drainage slopes with an adjustable blade.
A backhoe loader combines a front loading bucket with a rear digging arm for trenching and site work.
A vibratory roller compacts road and foundation material through drum weight and vibration.
A tower crane lifts construction loads along its jib, with lifting capacity depending on the load radius.
A concrete mixer truck keeps concrete mixed in a rotating drum while transporting it to the work site.
A 1 tonne electric winch winds wire rope onto a powered drum to pull material and equipment.
A 2 tonne electric winch uses a motor-driven drum and wire rope for material handling.
A 5 tonne mine winch uses a powered drum, wire rope and braking system to handle mining loads.
A mine hoist and headframe guide and control the rope used to move loads through a shaft.
Wire ropes, slings and lifting tackle connect a load to the lifting equipment for its planned duty.
A cone crusher reduces rock between a moving cone and a fixed liner, commonly after primary crushing.
A hammer mill breaks material with rotating hammers and controls the discharge size through a screen.
A wet pan mill grinds ore with heavy rollers moving around a pan containing water and feed material.
A vibrating screen separates material into size fractions as it moves across screened decks.
A trommel screen separates gravel by size as material passes through a rotating perforated drum.
A belt conveyor moves material between crushers, screens, stockpiles and other stages of a processing plant.
A hydrocyclone classifies particles in slurry, separating a finer overflow from a coarser underflow.
A filter press removes water from slurry through filter cloths, leaving solids as a filter cake.
A vibrating feeder delivers material from a hopper to a crusher at a controlled feed rate.
A rotary scrubber washes gravel in a rotating drum to break up clay before screening and recovery.
Sluices and jigs separate heavier gold particles from washed gravel using water flow and gravity.
An alluvial gold wash plant combines washing, screening and gravity separation to process gold-bearing gravel.
A centrifugal gold concentrator uses a spinning bowl and water to separate heavy gold particles from slurry.
An elution and electrowinning plant removes gold from loaded carbon and recovers it from solution onto electrodes.
CIL and CIP plants use leaching tanks and activated carbon to dissolve gold and collect it for recovery.
An agitated leaching tank keeps slurry and reagents mixed during the gold-dissolution stage.
A modular gold plant groups processing equipment into sections that can be transported and assembled on site.
A ball mill grinds crushed ore in a rotating drum containing steel grinding balls.
A jaw crusher breaks large rock between a fixed jaw and a moving jaw before further processing.
A gold shaking table separates heavy particles on a moving deck using water flow and gravity.
A bank of froth flotation cells: air bubbles carry mineral particles into the froth, which overflows to the concentrate launder while tailings leave the last cell.
A wet drum magnetic separator: a fixed magnet inside the rotating drum holds magnetic particles and carries them away from the non-magnetic stream.
A spiral classifier: fine material overflows at the low end while the rotating spiral rakes settled sand up the inclined trough and back to the mill.
A pneumatic jackleg drill uses compressed air to drill rock, supported by an adjustable pusher leg.
An RC drilling rig uses compressed air and dual-wall drill rods to bring rock-chip samples to the surface.
A gold prospecting metal detector uses a search coil to locate metal targets in the ground.
A slurry pump transfers water containing solid particles between stages of a processing plant.
A submersible dewatering pump operates below the water surface to drain sumps, shafts and work areas.
A mining helmet with a cap lamp combines head protection with lighting for underground work.
A self-contained self-rescuer provides a breathing supply for emergency escape from an unsafe atmosphere.
A multi-gas monitor measures selected gases and oxygen levels when assessing mine or confined-space conditions.
A full-body harness connects a worker to an appropriate fall-protection system when working at height.
A mine ventilation fan moves air through ducts or mine passages to support underground ventilation.
Mine management software brings production, shift and operating records together for planning and reporting.
A fleet management system tracks vehicle movements and operating records to help manage haulage.
Geological modelling software organises exploration data and builds models of geological structures and mineralisation.
A lighting tower raises floodlights above the work area to illuminate night operations.
A diesel generator combines a diesel engine and an alternator to supply electrical power to mining equipment.
A mining air compressor supplies compressed air for pneumatic drills and other air-powered equipment.

checks.h1: Mitambo na vifaa vya uchimbaji, uchakataji na usalama

images.alt: Mtambo wa dhahabu ya alluvial huunganisha kuosha, kuchuja na kutenganisha kwa tofauti za uzito ili kuchakata changarawe yenye dhahabu.
Excavator ya haidroliki hutumia mkono na ndoo yake kuchimba malighafi na kupakia malori.
Wheel loader huchota malighafi iliyolundikwa na kuipakia kwenye malori au hopper za kulishia mitambo.
Lori la kutipa hubeba madini, mawe ya mabaki na vifaa vya ujenzi kwenye sehemu ya mizigo inayoinuliwa kumwaga.
Bulldozer husukuma na kusambaza malighafi kwa bapa lake la mbele wakati wa kuandaa eneo na kujenga barabara.
Motor grader husawazisha barabara na kutengeneza mteremko wa kupitisha maji kwa bapa linalorekebishwa.
Backhoe loader ina ndoo ya kupakia mbele na mkono wa kuchimba nyuma kwa mitaro na kazi za eneo.
Rola ya mtetemo hushindilia malighafi ya barabara na misingi kwa uzito na mtetemo wa ngoma yake.
Kreni ya mnara huinua mizigo ya ujenzi kwa mkono wake, huku uwezo wa kuinua ukitegemea umbali wa mzigo kutoka kwenye mnara.
Lori la kuchanganya zege huzungusha ngoma yake ili zege liendelee kuchanganyika wakati wa kusafirishwa eneo la kazi.
Winchi ya umeme ya tani 1 hukusanya waya kwenye ngoma yenye mota ili kuvuta malighafi na vifaa.
Winchi ya umeme ya tani 2 hutumia ngoma inayoendeshwa na mota pamoja na waya kusogeza mizigo.
Winchi ya mgodini ya tani 5 hutumia ngoma yenye mota, waya na mfumo wa breki kushughulikia mizigo ya uchimbaji.
Hoist na mnara wa shimo huongoza na kudhibiti waya unaotumika kupandisha na kushusha mizigo shimoni.
Waya, mikanda ya kuinulia na viungio huunganisha mzigo na kifaa cha kuinua kulingana na kazi iliyopangwa.
Cone crusher hupunguza ukubwa wa mawe kati ya koni inayosogea na liner iliyotulia, kwa kawaida baada ya hatua ya kwanza ya kuponda.
Hammer mill huvunja malighafi kwa nyundo zinazozunguka na kudhibiti ukubwa unaotoka kupitia kichujio.
Wet pan mill husaga madini kwa rola nzito zinazozunguka ndani ya beseni lenye maji na malighafi.
Kichujio cha mtetemo hutenganisha malighafi kwa ukubwa inapopita juu ya tabaka zenye matundu ya kuchuja.
Trommel hutenganisha changarawe kwa ukubwa wakati malighafi inapita ndani ya ngoma inayozunguka yenye matundu.
Conveyor ya mkanda husafirisha malighafi kati ya mashine za kuponda, vichujio, malundo na hatua nyingine za mtambo.
Hydrocyclone hutenganisha chembe kwenye tope, ikitoa chembe laini juu na kundi kubwa zaidi chini.
Filter press huondoa maji kwenye tope kupitia vitambaa vya kuchuja na kuacha yabisi kama keki ya uchujaji.
Feeder ya mtetemo hupeleka malighafi kutoka hopper hadi mashine ya kuponda kwa kiwango kinachodhibitiwa.
Rotary scrubber huosha changarawe ndani ya ngoma inayozunguka ili kuvunja udongo kabla ya kuchuja na kutenganisha dhahabu.
Sluice na jig hutenganisha chembe nzito za dhahabu kutoka changarawe iliyooshwa kwa mtiririko wa maji na tofauti za uzito.
Mtambo wa dhahabu ya alluvial huunganisha kuosha, kuchuja na kutenganisha kwa tofauti za uzito ili kuchakata changarawe yenye dhahabu.
Concentrator ya centrifugal hutumia bakuli linalozunguka na maji kutenganisha chembe nzito za dhahabu kutoka kwenye tope.
Mtambo wa elution na electrowinning huondoa dhahabu kwenye kaboni iliyoibeba na kuikusanya kutoka kwenye myeyusho kwenye elektrodi.
Mitambo ya CIL na CIP hutumia matanki ya leaching na kaboni iliyoamilishwa kuyeyusha dhahabu na kuikusanya kwa hatua ya kuitoa.
Tanki la leaching lenye kichanganyio huweka tope na kemikali zikichanganyika wakati wa kuyeyusha dhahabu.
Mtambo wa dhahabu wa moduli huweka vifaa vya kuchakata katika sehemu zinazoweza kusafirishwa na kuunganishwa eneo la kazi.
Ball mill husaga madini yaliyopondwa ndani ya ngoma inayozunguka yenye mipira ya chuma ya kusagia.
Jaw crusher huvunja mawe makubwa kati ya taya iliyotulia na taya inayosogea kabla ya hatua nyingine za kuchakata.
Meza ya kutenganisha dhahabu hutenganisha chembe nzito kwenye uso unaosogea kwa mtiririko wa maji na tofauti za uzito.
Mfululizo wa seli za flotation: viputo vya hewa hubeba chembe za madini kwenye povu, linalomwagika kwenye mfereji wa madini yaliyokolezwa (concentrate) huku mabaki yakitoka kwenye seli ya mwisho.
Kitenganishi cha sumaku cha drum ya majimaji: sumaku isiyosogea ndani ya drum inayozunguka hushika chembe zinazovutwa na sumaku na kuzitenganisha na mkondo wa chembe zisizovutwa nayo.
Spiral classifier: chembe laini humwagika upande wa chini huku skrubu inayozunguka ikipandisha mchanga uliotulia kwenye mfereji wa chuma ulio na mteremko na kuurudisha kinuni.
Jackleg hutumia hewa iliyobanwa kuchimba mawe, huku mguu wake unaorekebishwa ukiishikilia na kuisukuma.
Rig ya RC hutumia hewa iliyobanwa na mabomba yenye njia mbili kuleta sampuli za vipande vya mawe juu ya ardhi.
Kigunduzi cha metali cha kutafuta dhahabu hutumia koili kutambua metali iliyo ardhini.
Pampu ya tope husafirisha maji yenye chembe za yabisi kati ya hatua za mtambo wa kuchakata.
Pampu ya kuzamishwa hufanya kazi chini ya maji kuyatoa kwenye mashimo ya kukusanyia, mashimo ya uchimbaji na maeneo ya kazi.
Kofia ya usalama yenye taa huunganisha kinga ya kichwa na mwanga kwa kazi chini ya ardhi.
Kifaa cha kujinusuru cha SCSR hutoa hewa ya kupumua kwa kuondoka kwa dharura kwenye mazingira yenye hewa isiyo salama.
Kipima gesi nyingi hupima gesi zilizochaguliwa na kiwango cha oksijeni wakati wa kutathmini hali ya mgodi au sehemu iliyofungwa.
Harness ya mwili mzima humuunganisha mfanyakazi na mfumo unaofaa wa kujikinga na kuanguka anapofanya kazi sehemu ya juu.
Feni ya mgodini husukuma hewa kupitia mabomba au njia za mgodi kusaidia uingizaji na utoaji wa hewa chini ya ardhi.
Programu ya usimamizi wa mgodi hukusanya taarifa za uzalishaji, zamu na uendeshaji kwa kupanga kazi na kutoa ripoti.
Mfumo wa usimamizi wa magari hufuatilia mienendo na taarifa za uendeshaji ili kusaidia kusimamia usafirishaji wa mizigo.
Programu ya uundaji wa modeli za jiolojia hupanga data za utafiti na kuunda modeli za miundo ya ardhi na madini.
Mnara wa taa huinua taa juu ya eneo la kazi ili kuangaza shughuli za usiku.
Jenereta ya dizeli huunganisha injini ya dizeli na alternator kuzalisha umeme kwa vifaa vya uchimbaji.
Compressor ya mgodini hutoa hewa iliyobanwa kwa mashine za kuchimba na vifaa vingine vinavyoendeshwa kwa hewa.

checks.h1: Machinery, plant and safety equipment

images.alt: An alluvial gold wash plant combines washing, screening and gravity separation to process gold-bearing gravel.
A hydraulic excavator uses its boom and bucket to dig material and load haul trucks.
A wheel loader scoops loose material from stockpiles and loads it into trucks or feed hoppers.
A dump truck carries ore, waste rock and construction material in a tipping body.
A bulldozer pushes and spreads material with its front blade during site preparation and road work.
A motor grader shapes road surfaces and drainage slopes with an adjustable blade.
A backhoe loader combines a front loading bucket with a rear digging arm for trenching and site work.
A vibratory roller compacts road and foundation material through drum weight and vibration.
A tower crane lifts construction loads along its jib, with lifting capacity depending on the load radius.
A concrete mixer truck keeps concrete mixed in a rotating drum while transporting it to the work site.
A 1 tonne electric winch winds wire rope onto a powered drum to pull material and equipment.
A 2 tonne electric winch uses a motor-driven drum and wire rope for material handling.
A 5 tonne mine winch uses a powered drum, wire rope and braking system to handle mining loads.
A mine hoist and headframe guide and control the rope used to move loads through a shaft.
Wire ropes, slings and lifting tackle connect a load to the lifting equipment for its planned duty.
A cone crusher reduces rock between a moving cone and a fixed liner, commonly after primary crushing.
A hammer mill breaks material with rotating hammers and controls the discharge size through a screen.
A wet pan mill grinds ore with heavy rollers moving around a pan containing water and feed material.
A vibrating screen separates material into size fractions as it moves across screened decks.
A trommel screen separates gravel by size as material passes through a rotating perforated drum.
A belt conveyor moves material between crushers, screens, stockpiles and other stages of a processing plant.
A hydrocyclone classifies particles in slurry, separating a finer overflow from a coarser underflow.
A filter press removes water from slurry through filter cloths, leaving solids as a filter cake.
A vibrating feeder delivers material from a hopper to a crusher at a controlled feed rate.
A rotary scrubber washes gravel in a rotating drum to break up clay before screening and recovery.
Sluices and jigs separate heavier gold particles from washed gravel using water flow and gravity.
An alluvial gold wash plant combines washing, screening and gravity separation to process gold-bearing gravel.
A centrifugal gold concentrator uses a spinning bowl and water to separate heavy gold particles from slurry.
An elution and electrowinning plant removes gold from loaded carbon and recovers it from solution onto electrodes.
CIL and CIP plants use leaching tanks and activated carbon to dissolve gold and collect it for recovery.
An agitated leaching tank keeps slurry and reagents mixed during the gold-dissolution stage.
A modular gold plant groups processing equipment into sections that can be transported and assembled on site.
A ball mill grinds crushed ore in a rotating drum containing steel grinding balls.
A jaw crusher breaks large rock between a fixed jaw and a moving jaw before further processing.
A gold shaking table separates heavy particles on a moving deck using water flow and gravity.
A bank of froth flotation cells: air bubbles carry mineral particles into the froth, which overflows to the concentrate launder while tailings leave the last cell.
A wet drum magnetic separator: a fixed magnet inside the rotating drum holds magnetic particles and carries them away from the non-magnetic stream.
A spiral classifier: fine material overflows at the low end while the rotating spiral rakes settled sand up the inclined trough and back to the mill.
A pneumatic jackleg drill uses compressed air to drill rock, supported by an adjustable pusher leg.
An RC drilling rig uses compressed air and dual-wall drill rods to bring rock-chip samples to the surface.
A gold prospecting metal detector uses a search coil to locate metal targets in the ground.
A slurry pump transfers water containing solid particles between stages of a processing plant.
A submersible dewatering pump operates below the water surface to drain sumps, shafts and work areas.
A mining helmet with a cap lamp combines head protection with lighting for underground work.
A self-contained self-rescuer provides a breathing supply for emergency escape from an unsafe atmosphere.
A multi-gas monitor measures selected gases and oxygen levels when assessing mine or confined-space conditions.
A full-body harness connects a worker to an appropriate fall-protection system when working at height.
A mine ventilation fan moves air through ducts or mine passages to support underground ventilation.
Mine management software brings production, shift and operating records together for planning and reporting.
A fleet management system tracks vehicle movements and operating records to help manage haulage.
Geological modelling software organises exploration data and builds models of geological structures and mineralisation.
A lighting tower raises floodlights above the work area to illuminate night operations.
A diesel generator combines a diesel engine and an alternator to supply electrical power to mining equipment.
A mining air compressor supplies compressed air for pneumatic drills and other air-powered equipment.

checks.h1: Mitambo na vifaa vya uchimbaji, uchakataji na usalama

images.alt: Mtambo wa dhahabu ya alluvial huunganisha kuosha, kuchuja na kutenganisha kwa tofauti za uzito ili kuchakata changarawe yenye dhahabu.
Excavator ya haidroliki hutumia mkono na ndoo yake kuchimba malighafi na kupakia malori.
Wheel loader huchota malighafi iliyolundikwa na kuipakia kwenye malori au hopper za kulishia mitambo.
Lori la kutipa hubeba madini, mawe ya mabaki na vifaa vya ujenzi kwenye sehemu ya mizigo inayoinuliwa kumwaga.
Bulldozer husukuma na kusambaza malighafi kwa bapa lake la mbele wakati wa kuandaa eneo na kujenga barabara.
Motor grader husawazisha barabara na kutengeneza mteremko wa kupitisha maji kwa bapa linalorekebishwa.
Backhoe loader ina ndoo ya kupakia mbele na mkono wa kuchimba nyuma kwa mitaro na kazi za eneo.
Rola ya mtetemo hushindilia malighafi ya barabara na misingi kwa uzito na mtetemo wa ngoma yake.
Kreni ya mnara huinua mizigo ya ujenzi kwa mkono wake, huku uwezo wa kuinua ukitegemea umbali wa mzigo kutoka kwenye mnara.
Lori la kuchanganya zege huzungusha ngoma yake ili zege liendelee kuchanganyika wakati wa kusafirishwa eneo la kazi.
Winchi ya umeme ya tani 1 hukusanya waya kwenye ngoma yenye mota ili kuvuta malighafi na vifaa.
Winchi ya umeme ya tani 2 hutumia ngoma inayoendeshwa na mota pamoja na waya kusogeza mizigo.
Winchi ya mgodini ya tani 5 hutumia ngoma yenye mota, waya na mfumo wa breki kushughulikia mizigo ya uchimbaji.
Hoist na mnara wa shimo huongoza na kudhibiti waya unaotumika kupandisha na kushusha mizigo shimoni.
Waya, mikanda ya kuinulia na viungio huunganisha mzigo na kifaa cha kuinua kulingana na kazi iliyopangwa.
Cone crusher hupunguza ukubwa wa mawe kati ya koni inayosogea na liner iliyotulia, kwa kawaida baada ya hatua ya kwanza ya kuponda.
Hammer mill huvunja malighafi kwa nyundo zinazozunguka na kudhibiti ukubwa unaotoka kupitia kichujio.
Wet pan mill husaga madini kwa rola nzito zinazozunguka ndani ya beseni lenye maji na malighafi.
Kichujio cha mtetemo hutenganisha malighafi kwa ukubwa inapopita juu ya tabaka zenye matundu ya kuchuja.
Trommel hutenganisha changarawe kwa ukubwa wakati malighafi inapita ndani ya ngoma inayozunguka yenye matundu.
Conveyor ya mkanda husafirisha malighafi kati ya mashine za kuponda, vichujio, malundo na hatua nyingine za mtambo.
Hydrocyclone hutenganisha chembe kwenye tope, ikitoa chembe laini juu na kundi kubwa zaidi chini.
Filter press huondoa maji kwenye tope kupitia vitambaa vya kuchuja na kuacha yabisi kama keki ya uchujaji.
Feeder ya mtetemo hupeleka malighafi kutoka hopper hadi mashine ya kuponda kwa kiwango kinachodhibitiwa.
Rotary scrubber huosha changarawe ndani ya ngoma inayozunguka ili kuvunja udongo kabla ya kuchuja na kutenganisha dhahabu.
Sluice na jig hutenganisha chembe nzito za dhahabu kutoka changarawe iliyooshwa kwa mtiririko wa maji na tofauti za uzito.
Mtambo wa dhahabu ya alluvial huunganisha kuosha, kuchuja na kutenganisha kwa tofauti za uzito ili kuchakata changarawe yenye dhahabu.
Concentrator ya centrifugal hutumia bakuli linalozunguka na maji kutenganisha chembe nzito za dhahabu kutoka kwenye tope.
Mtambo wa elution na electrowinning huondoa dhahabu kwenye kaboni iliyoibeba na kuikusanya kutoka kwenye myeyusho kwenye elektrodi.
Mitambo ya CIL na CIP hutumia matanki ya leaching na kaboni iliyoamilishwa kuyeyusha dhahabu na kuikusanya kwa hatua ya kuitoa.
Tanki la leaching lenye kichanganyio huweka tope na kemikali zikichanganyika wakati wa kuyeyusha dhahabu.
Mtambo wa dhahabu wa moduli huweka vifaa vya kuchakata katika sehemu zinazoweza kusafirishwa na kuunganishwa eneo la kazi.
Ball mill husaga madini yaliyopondwa ndani ya ngoma inayozunguka yenye mipira ya chuma ya kusagia.
Jaw crusher huvunja mawe makubwa kati ya taya iliyotulia na taya inayosogea kabla ya hatua nyingine za kuchakata.
Meza ya kutenganisha dhahabu hutenganisha chembe nzito kwenye uso unaosogea kwa mtiririko wa maji na tofauti za uzito.
Mfululizo wa seli za flotation: viputo vya hewa hubeba chembe za madini kwenye povu, linalomwagika kwenye mfereji wa madini yaliyokolezwa (concentrate) huku mabaki yakitoka kwenye seli ya mwisho.
Kitenganishi cha sumaku cha drum ya majimaji: sumaku isiyosogea ndani ya drum inayozunguka hushika chembe zinazovutwa na sumaku na kuzitenganisha na mkondo wa chembe zisizovutwa nayo.
Spiral classifier: chembe laini humwagika upande wa chini huku skrubu inayozunguka ikipandisha mchanga uliotulia kwenye mfereji wa chuma ulio na mteremko na kuurudisha kinuni.
Jackleg hutumia hewa iliyobanwa kuchimba mawe, huku mguu wake unaorekebishwa ukiishikilia na kuisukuma.
Rig ya RC hutumia hewa iliyobanwa na mabomba yenye njia mbili kuleta sampuli za vipande vya mawe juu ya ardhi.
Kigunduzi cha metali cha kutafuta dhahabu hutumia koili kutambua metali iliyo ardhini.
Pampu ya tope husafirisha maji yenye chembe za yabisi kati ya hatua za mtambo wa kuchakata.
Pampu ya kuzamishwa hufanya kazi chini ya maji kuyatoa kwenye mashimo ya kukusanyia, mashimo ya uchimbaji na maeneo ya kazi.
Kofia ya usalama yenye taa huunganisha kinga ya kichwa na mwanga kwa kazi chini ya ardhi.
Kifaa cha kujinusuru cha SCSR hutoa hewa ya kupumua kwa kuondoka kwa dharura kwenye mazingira yenye hewa isiyo salama.
Kipima gesi nyingi hupima gesi zilizochaguliwa na kiwango cha oksijeni wakati wa kutathmini hali ya mgodi au sehemu iliyofungwa.
Harness ya mwili mzima humuunganisha mfanyakazi na mfumo unaofaa wa kujikinga na kuanguka anapofanya kazi sehemu ya juu.
Feni ya mgodini husukuma hewa kupitia mabomba au njia za mgodi kusaidia uingizaji na utoaji wa hewa chini ya ardhi.
Programu ya usimamizi wa mgodi hukusanya taarifa za uzalishaji, zamu na uendeshaji kwa kupanga kazi na kutoa ripoti.
Mfumo wa usimamizi wa magari hufuatilia mienendo na taarifa za uendeshaji ili kusaidia kusimamia usafirishaji wa mizigo.
Programu ya uundaji wa modeli za jiolojia hupanga data za utafiti na kuunda modeli za miundo ya ardhi na madini.
Mnara wa taa huinua taa juu ya eneo la kazi ili kuangaza shughuli za usiku.
Jenereta ya dizeli huunganisha injini ya dizeli na alternator kuzalisha umeme kwa vifaa vya uchimbaji.
Compressor ya mgodini hutoa hewa iliyobanwa kwa mashine za kuchimba na vifaa vingine vinavyoendeshwa kwa hewa.

checks.h1: Leach Tank Volume Calculator for CIL and CIP Plants
Kikokotoo cha ujazo wa tanki la leaching (CIL na CIP)
